title: French Line kids' band and Columbia Blue Lions
summary: The kids' band plays French Line ships; at Columbia he joins the Blue Lions and studies liberal arts.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I must have been in high school, beginning with the first year already; it had to be that. I had a friend of the family who was a passenger agent, American passenger agent, for the French Line,
and he got us dates every summer for the kids band, going back and forth playing on the French Line, which was quite an experience.
Of all things, the French Line was the peak of it.
What was it, a ten piece band?
No, three or four or five; we'd go from one end of the ship to the other.
That was the high school period.

Then I went to Columbia after that and a similar thing happened there. I joined the Columbia Blue Lions which was there college jazz band, I guess. They had no music department at Columbia, I couldn't study music there.
